optimized_sql:
select *
from (
    select i_category,
           i_class,
           i_brand,
           i_product_name,
           d_year,
           d_qoy,
           d_moy,
           s_store_id,
           sumsales,
           rank() over (partition by i_category order by sumsales desc) as rk
    from (
        select i_category,
               i_class,
               i_brand,
               i_product_name,
               d_year,
               d_qoy,
               d_moy,
               s_store_id,
               sum(coalesce(ss_sales_price * ss_quantity, 0)) as sumsales
        from store
        join store_sales on store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
        join date_dim on store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
        join item on store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
        where date_dim.d_month_seq between 1217 and 1217 + 11
        group by rollup(i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id)
    ) as dw1
) as dw2
where rk <= 100
order by i_category,
         i_class,
         i_brand,
         i_product_name,
         d_year,
         d_qoy,
         d_moy,
         s_store_id,
         sumsales,
         rk
limit 100
